children.text: B2B Portal and Website Development in Saudi Arabia

At Nalk Solutions, we build B2B platforms that move real business. As a specialist B2B portal and website development company in Saudi Arabia, we deliver B2B website development services and custom B2B portal development for companies that sell to other businesses, manage dealer networks, or need secure self-service systems for clients and suppliers. From Riyadh and Jeddah to Dammam and the wider Eastern Province, we design B2B websites and web portals that shorten sales cycles, cut manual work, and give your partners a fast, secure place to do business with you.

Whether you need a lead-generating B2B website, a customer portal where clients place and track orders, or a bespoke operational system that ties into your ERP, we build B2B platforms that align with Saudi Arabia’s Vision 2030 digital transformation goals and scale with your operations.

Nalk Solutions builds B2B portals and websites for the sectors that run Saudi Arabia’s economy. We work with manufacturing and industrial firms, wholesale and distribution businesses, logistics and supply chain companies, construction and contracting groups, healthcare and medical suppliers, energy and oil field services, and professional and financial services teams across Riyadh, Jeddah, and Dammam. Whatever the sector, the need is the same: secure portals and B2B platforms that connect you to your clients, dealers, and suppliers, cut manual work, and keep business moving.
B2B Website and Portal Development Services in Saudi Arabia

B2B is a different game from the consumer web. Your buyers are procurement teams, distributors, and account managers who need information fast and expect systems that work. Our B2B website and portal development services in Saudi Arabia are built around that reality, combining marketing sites that generate qualified leads with portals that run the work behind them.

Our B2B website development services in Saudi Arabia are built to win business buyers, not just impress them. We create sites structured around long sales cycles, multiple decision makers, and the trust signals that matter in B2B, including detailed service pages, case studies, technical specifications, and clear paths to a sales conversation. Every B2B website we build is bilingual-ready with proper Arabic and English support, fast on mobile, and optimised so procurement teams find you in search.

What is the difference between a B2B website and a B2B portal?

A B2B website is a public marketing site that presents your services and generates leads. A B2B portal is a secure, login-based platform where clients, vendors, or staff place orders, manage accounts, and access documents. Many companies need both, and we build them to work together.
How much does B2B portal development cost in Saudi Arabia?

Portal projects are quoted on scope, since features, integrations, and user roles vary widely. Simpler customer portals generally start from SAR 25,000, while larger multi-role platforms with ERP integration are scoped after a discovery session. We provide a detailed quote once we understand your workflows and requirements.
How long does it take to build a B2B portal?

Timelines depend on scope and integrations. A focused customer portal with core features usually takes 6 to 10 weeks. A larger multi-role platform with ERP integration, custom dashboards, and several user types typically runs 3 to 5 months. During discovery we give you a fixed milestone schedule so you know what lands and when, rather than an open-ended estimate.
Can you integrate our portal with our existing ERP or CRM?

Yes. We connect B2B portals to the systems you already run, including ERP, CRM, accounting, and inventory tools, through secure APIs. This keeps orders, accounts, and documents in sync across platforms instead of being rekeyed by hand. We have experience integrating with the enterprise tools commonly used across Saudi businesses and will confirm your specific systems during discovery.
Will the portal support both Arabic and English?

Yes. Every portal we build supports full right-to-left Arabic alongside English, with correct layout, formatting, and text direction across the whole interface. Our Arabic specialists make sure labels, messages, and content read naturally to Saudi users, so your teams and partners get a proper bilingual experience rather than a machine translation.
